description: Powerful 1020W Copper Motor – Experience high performance with a robust copper motor, delivering efficient power for demanding tasks with a no-load speed of 970 RPM and 4800bmp impact force. Versatile 2-in-1 Functionality – This rotary hammer drill offers both hammering and hammer drilling functions, allowing you to easily switch between hammer drilling, breaking, and grooving applications for maximum versatility. SDS Plus Chuck & Drill Bits – Equipped with an SDS Plus chuck, this heavy-duty rotary hammer drill machine includes 6mm, 8mm, and 10mm drill bits, ensuring compatibility with a variety of tasks including wall drilling. Pointed & Flat Chisels – Includes a flat chisel for grooving and a pointed chisel for breaking, perfect for tough materials like concrete and masonry during wall drilling and demolition. Convenient Sturdy Carry Case & LED Power Indicator – Protect and easily transport your rotary hammer drill with the included sturdy carry case, while the LED power indicator keeps you informed of power status for uninterrupted work.
